request.query: What changed in the UPI Lite limits addendum compared with the baseline? Include source-backed conditions and dates, and identify unresolved points.

claims.text: The Addendum to Enhancement in UPI LITE Limits (2025-OC-169A) issued on 27th February 2025 revised the transaction limits previously set by NPCI/UPI/OC No. 169/2023-24 dated 31st August 2023.
The baseline provision in the cited source established a per transaction limit of ₹500 and a maximum balance in the UPI LITE account of ₹2000, effective from 31st August 2023.
claims.original_text: The baseline provision in document 2023-UPI-169 established a per transaction limit of ₹500 and a maximum balance in the UPI LITE account of ₹2000, effective from 31st August 2023.

claims.text: The revised provision in the cited source increased the per transaction limit to ₹1000 and the total limit at any point in time to ₹5000, effective immediately upon issuance on 27th February 2025.
claims.original_text: The revised provision in document 2025-OC-169A increased the per transaction limit to ₹1000 and the total limit at any point in time to ₹5000, effective immediately upon issuance on 27th February 2025.

claims.text: The addendum also introduced a new requirement for issuer banks to identify dormant UPI LITE accounts with zero transactions in the past six months and refund balances by 30th June 2025, which was not present in the baseline document.

reasons: The local model accepted the selected evidence as support.

quotes.quote: NPCI/UPI/OC No. 169 A/2024-25 — 27th February 2025 To, All UPI Members Dear Sir/Madam, **Subject: Addendum to Enhancement in UPI LITE Limits** With reference to the NPCI/UPI/OC No. 138/2021-22, dated 16th March 2022 and NPCI/UPI/OC No. 169/2023-24, dated 31st August 2023, UPI LITE was introduced and transaction limit was increased from ₹200 from ₹500 respectively. > Transcription note: the source itself uses “from ₹200 from ₹500”; that wording is retained.

NPCI/UPI/OC No. 169/2023-24 31st August 2023 To All Member-Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Dear Madam/Sir, **Subject: Enhancement in UPI LITE transaction limit to ₹500** UPI LITE has been designed to play a vital role in reducing infrastructure load on the Core Banking System of the banks. This feature has been making the small value transactions faster and highly reliable for transaction value below ₹200. As per the latest circular issued by RBI on 24th August, 2023 vide Circular No: RBI/2023-24/57 CO.DPSS.POLC.No.S526/02-14-003/2023-24 with subject ‘Enhancing transaction limits for Small Value Digital Payments in Offline Mode’, the upper limit of an offline payment transaction is now increased from ₹200 to ₹500. In view of the above, the per transaction value limit for UPI LITE (Purpose code 44 - Online and 45 - Offline) has now been enhanced to ₹500. The details are as below: | UPI LITE Limit | Previous Limit | New Limit | |---|---|---| | Per Transaction | ₹200 | ₹500 | | Max balance in UPI lite account | ₹2000 | ₹2000 (No change) | The existing UPI pricing shall be applicable for transaction amount ₹201-₹500 for both P2P and P2M transactions. With reference to the above, Member Banks (Payee PSP), Third Party App providers (TPAPs), Merchants and other payment providers are requested to take note of the above enhancement

reasons: The local model accepted the selected evidence as support.

quotes.quote: 1. As per the latest notification issued by RBI on 4th December 2024 vide circular no. RBI/2021-22/146 CO.DPSS.POLC.No.S1264/02-14-003/2021-2022 with subject ‘Framework for Facilitating Small Value Digital Payments in Offline Mode’, for UPI LITE, the enhanced limits shall be ₹1,000 per transaction with ₹5,000 being the total limit. Replenishment of used limit shall be allowed only in online mode with AFA. Customer will further have the option to set Auto Top-up for limit replenishment as per NPCI circular, ‘Introduction of Auto Top-up on UPI LITE’, vide No. NPCI/UPI/OC No. 205/2024-25, dated 27th August 2024. The details of the LITE limits are as below: | Description | UPI LITE — Existing | UPI LITE — New | UPI LITE X (Offline) — No Change | |---|---|---|---| | Per Transaction Limit | ₹500 | ₹1000 | ₹500 | | Total Limit at any point in time | ₹2000 | ₹5000 | ₹2000 | The new limits shall apply to and govern all existing NPCI circulars pertaining to UPI LITE limit (Annexure A). All the members are required to make the necessary changes pertaining to limit increase immediately.

reasons: The local model accepted the selected evidence as support.

quotes.quote: 2. Issuer banks live on UPI LITE shall identify all the UPI LITE accounts that have had zero transactions in the past six months. Any balances in these dormant LITE accounts shall be refunded to the source bank account. Issuer banks shall implement the changes by 30th June 2025. Yours sincerely, SD/- Kunal Kalawatia Chief of Product

sources.text: NPCI/UPI/OC No. 169/2023-24 31st August 2023 To All Member-Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Dear Madam/Sir, **Subject: Enhancement in UPI LITE transaction limit to ₹500** UPI LITE has been designed to play a vital role in reducing infrastructure load on the Core Banking System of the banks. This feature has been making the small value transactions faster and highly reliable for transaction value below ₹200. As per the latest circular issued by RBI on 24th August, 2023 vide Circular No: RBI/2023-24/57 CO.DPSS.POLC.No.S526/02-14-003/2023-24 with subject ‘Enhancing transaction limits for Small Value Digital Payments in Offline Mode’, the upper limit of an offline payment transaction is now increased from ₹200 to ₹500. In view of the above, the per transaction value limit for UPI LITE (Purpose code 44 - Online and 45 - Offline) has now been enhanced to ₹500. The details are as below: | UPI LITE Limit | Previous Limit | New Limit | |---|---|---| | Per Transaction | ₹200 | ₹500 | | Max balance in UPI lite account | ₹2000 | ₹2000 (No change) | The existing UPI pricing shall be applicable for transaction amount ₹201-₹500 for both P2P and P2M transactions. With reference to the above, Member Banks (Payee PSP), Third Party App providers (TPAPs), Merchants and other payment providers are requested to take note of the above enhancement

versions.text:
The Addendum to Enhancement in UPI LITE Limits (2025-OC-169A) issued on 27th February 2025 revised the transaction limits previously set by NPCI/UPI/OC No. 169/2023-24 dated 31st August 2023. [S1, S2]

The baseline provision in the cited source established a per transaction limit of ₹500 and a maximum balance in the UPI LITE account of ₹2000, effective from 31st August 2023. [S2]

The revised provision in the cited source increased the per transaction limit to ₹1000 and the total limit at any point in time to ₹5000, effective immediately upon issuance on 27th February 2025. [S5]

The addendum also introduced a new requirement for issuer banks to identify dormant UPI LITE accounts with zero transactions in the past six months and refund balances by 30th June 2025, which was not present in the baseline document. [S7]
